'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**A [[car bomb]]ing kills at least five people and injures 22 others in the [[Turkey|Turkish]]-occupied town of [[Afrin, Syria|Afrin]] in northern [[Syria]]. Turkey's [[Ministry of National Defense (Turkey)|Ministry of National Defense]] accuses the [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-led [[People's Protection Units|YPG]] of being behind the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-turkey-blast/bomb-blast-kills-at-least-five-people-in-northern-syrian-town-of-afrin-idUSKBN29Z0L7?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Maryland]], [[501.V2 variant]]
*****[[Maryland]] confirms its first case of the 501.V2 variant from [[South Africa]], becoming the second [[U.S. state]] to do so after [[South Carolina]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2021/01/30/maryland-south-africa-covid-19-variant-463984 (''Politico'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Carolina]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[South Carolina]] reports its first case of the B.1.1.7 variant first detected in the [[United Kingdom]]. The patient is a person from the [[Pee Dee]] region who previously travelled internationally. [https://www.wltx.com/article/news/health/coronavirus/first-case-of-uk-covid-19-variant-found-in-south-carolina-dhec/101-50b1b37d-752b-409e-97e9-b93b65c61ef7 (WLTX-TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cuba]]
****[[Cuba]]n authorities announce that the country will tighten its measures to reduce the spread of [[COVID-19]] and require all [[tourism in Cuba|tourists]] to isolate after visiting the island until they [[COVID-19 testing|test]] negative. [https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-latin-america-cuba-f1d882cbcb971f4b8ab6560392e66f14 (AP)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record 14,518 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, 4,601 of which are from [[West Java]], bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,066,313. [https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5354875/jabar-tembus-4-ribu-kasus-ini-sebaran-14518-kasus-covid-19-ri-30-januari (detikHealth)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] imposes a 14-day quarantine upon arrival for all travelers from [[Europe]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-iran-idUSKBN29Z0HQ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record 5,728 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 209,661. [https://www.nst.com.my/news/nation/2021/01/661769/record-5728-new-covid-19-cases-today-says-dr-adham (''New Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
****[[Taiwan]] reports its first death from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] since May 2020 in a woman in her 80s. [https://focustaiwan.tw/society/202101300004 (''Focus Taiwan News Channel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan]]
****[[Uzbekistan]] reports its first case of the [[Variant of Concern 202012/01|UK variant]] of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] in a 10-year-old child who travelled with her family to the [[United Arab Emirates]] last week. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/asiapacific/2021-01/30/c_139709785.htm (Xinhua)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]] approves the use of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|AstraZeneca vaccine]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/vietnam-reports-34-new-covid-19-cases-speeds-up-vaccine-procurement (''The Straits Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Algeria]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Algeria]] begins its vaccination program using [[Russia]]'s [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] vaccine. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/algeria-launches-covid-19-vaccination-campaign-75578956 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Tunisia]] becomes the third country in [[Africa]] to register the Russian-made Sputnik V vaccine after the country approves the vaccine for one year. [https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2021/01/31/Coronavirus-Coronavirus-Tunisia-registers-Russia-s-Sputnik-V-COVID-19-vaccine (Al-Arabiya)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
***The [[Italian Medicines Agency]] approves the use of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|AstraZeneca vaccine]] in [[Italy]] for all adults but recommends that other vaccines be given to people aged over 55. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/italy-cautious-on-astrazeneca-vaccine-for-over-55s (''Daily Sabah'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Economic effects of Brexit]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] announces that it will apply to join the [[Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership]], which forms a [[trade bloc]] of 11 [[Asia-Pacific]] nations. The UK will be the first non-founding country to apply to join the bloc. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-55871373 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Iran]]
**[[Iran]] [[Hanging|hangs]] Javid Dehghan, the former leader of the [[salafi jihadism|Salafi jihadist]] group [[Jaish ul-Adl]], for the [[murder]] of two [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] members in [[Sistan and Baluchestan Province]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-execution/iran-hangs-baluch-militant-for-killing-of-two-revolutionary-guards-judiciary-says-idUSKBN29Z0AR?il=0 (Reuters)]
